weight_description: Weight not yet sourced for the complete left/right SL-6208-6BCAI six-speed SIS/friction pair. The catalogue abbreviates it as SL-6208-BCAI; its 69 g FCAI figure does not explicitly identify a pair basis and is not doubled or assigned to another mount.
